summary: @types/node is pinned to ^26.6.6 while README promises Node 22 and newer; no current code uses a Node-26-only API, so the risk is latent
evidence: apps/desktop/package.json:17; package-lock.json:914-922; README.md:9; vite.config.ts:6 is the only Node API consumer
failure_scenario: If later config or test code uses an API added after Node 22, it type-checks but fails at runtime on Node 22. Related FND-0151.
